card.name: Linking words before a drug or lab name
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or units (including, and, of, to, serum, g) that sit right before a named drug or lab test such as ampicillin, amoxicillin, erythromycin or calcitonin in label text.

modes.label: Before antibiotic names
modes.description: A linking word or unit right before an antibiotic name.
modes.example: has been reported with use of nearly all antibacterial agents,<< including>> Ampicillin

modes.label: Before a lab test
modes.description: The word serum or a comma before a hormone or lab test name.
modes.example: Routine monitoring of<< serum>> calcitonin or using thyroid ultrasound is

modes.label: Between dose and drug
modes.description: A unit or of between an amount and the drug name.
modes.example: 0.5 g sulbactam to 2<< g>> ampicillin/1 g sulb

card.plain: It fires on the small word just ahead of a drug or lab test name, when that name is expected next.
